annotations.title: Search CJEU and ECHR case law

description: Search European case law: CJEU and General Court rulings, Advocate General opinions, AND European Court of Human Rights judgments and decisions (74,884 of them, 5,038 against Romania). One row per case; with court='toate' the two courts are interleaved. LANGUAGES: write `query` in Romanian, and ALSO pass the same question in English as `query_en` and in French as `query_fr` — CJEU case law is held in Romanian, English or French (19,344 of 41,233 rulings only in English or French) and ECHR judgments only in English or French, and the renderings are what reach them. Use against_romania=true for Strasbourg cases against Romania, and convention_article for a specific Convention article.

query.description: The legal problem, described, in Romanian.

query_en.description: The same question in English, in the courts' own terms (e.g. 'unfair terms in consumer contracts').

query_fr.description: The same question in French, in the CJEU's terms (e.g. 'clauses abusives dans les contrats conclus avec les consommateurs').

name: search_eu_jurisprudence
